response.sql:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
), kept AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages AS ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity > oa.overall_avg
), kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS kept_avg
  FROM kept
)
SELECT k.equipref,
       k.avg_humidity,
       k.avg_humidity - oa.overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
       k.avg_humidity - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_average
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND ka.kept_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-equipment averages; equipment with no non-NULL humidity readings has a NULL average and is excluded from both reference averages.
